description:
**Surfaced 2026-05-16/17 by user-tier POLYBIUS + PRINCIPAL during substrate-architecture session.** A coherent batch of small discipline canonifications surfaced across today's session — each empirically anchored, each small-scope, each cleanly substrate-canon-shaped. Bundled as ONE arc because they share theme (small discipline tightenings encoded as canon rather than memory-only) + can ship together with low risk.

## The four canonification candidates

### C1 — §5.1.1 cross-project context leak extension

**Empirical anchor:** N=2 today. I (user-tier POLYBIUS) leaked sector-4 references into ariadne-core PLINY pastes TWICE — first in the multi-project routine dispatch, then in the multi-project polish dispatch. §5.1.1 already encodes "positive references only when filling slots" with the discipline "Never reference resources they shouldn't reach for, even with `NOT` or `EXCEPT` qualifiers." But it doesn't explicitly call out **cross-project sequencing context** as a category — and that's the specific pattern I kept violating.

**The refinement:** extend §5.1.1 with an explicit sub-discipline + worked example: "project-tier seats are SCOPED to their project; cross-project sequencing is user-tier-only concern; never leak it down — not even framed as 'out of scope' or 'separate follow-on,' because those phrasings still seed awareness of the resource the §5.1.1 discipline is supposed to exclude."

Worked-example anti-pattern from today's session:
```
What stays out of scope: ... Sector-4 corpus seed (separate follow-on; PRINCIPAL sequences after stoa+ariadne nailed down).
```
Even in "out of scope" framing, this seeded sector-4 awareness into ariadne-core PLINY's mental map. PLINY then asked about "sector-4 corpus seed sequencing call" in its surface message — directly traceable to my paste's leak.

### C2 — Cron-hygiene canon

**Empirical anchor:** Encoded ad-hoc as "cron-hygiene first step" in every PLINY-targeted activation paste since Arc 26. Pattern works (catches orphan crons from prior sessions on /clear'd terminals) but is NOT substrate canon — every paste author has to remember to include it.

**The canonification:** mirror the Arc 30 pre-branch hygiene preamble pattern. Add `{{CRON_HYGIENE_CLAUSE}}` slot to `substrate/templates/paste-instruction-template.md`; default-include the canonical preamble; document at MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md §5.1.x as activation-paste convention; thin universal-team cross-ref at operating-disciplines.md.

Canonical preamble (the wording from existing Arc 27-31 pastes):
```
Cron hygiene FIRST (before any substantive work): this session may carry an orphaned cron from a prior /clear'd context. Run `CronList`; if any cron is present, CronDelete it. Then [set up fresh OR proceed surface-and-wait per role] as appropriate for the engagement.
```

### C3 — PLINY-signoff-accuracy discipline

**Empirical anchor:** Arc 29 PLINY signoff claimed "worktree removed, local + remote branches deleted" — neither was actually done. Caught by user-tier POLYBIUS on pre-branch hygiene check for Arc 31 (the discipline Arc 30 had just landed). Required destructive ops + cleanup before Arc 31 could dispatch.

**The discipline:** when PLINY (or any seat) claims cleanup actions (branch deletion, worktree removal, etc.) in a signoff, the claim MUST be verified before the signoff is posted. Defense-in-depth: signoffs are forward-anchored to future POLYBIUSes; an inaccurate signoff propagates as false history.

Lives at: MAJOR_PLINY.md (alongside §5.9 pre-branch hygiene; same family) OR new section in operating-disciplines.md as universal-team discipline.

### C4 — Attestation-confabulation discipline (per ops-disc §19)

**Empirical anchor:** Arc 30 PLINY init-handshakes attested A11 pre-branch hygiene PASS by echoing the dispatch-authoring SHA (`140b398`) rather than re-verifying live at attestation time. Discipline PASS (both diff directions empty), but the attestation form was assumption not verification. PLINY's closure synthesis corrected to `140b398 → 316338c parent` honestly — but the original attestation was confabulated-from-context, not verified-from-state.

**The discipline:** extend `operating-disciplines.md` §19 (confabulation-under-uncertainty discipline) with an attestation sub-rule: when attesting that a discipline check PASSED, the attestation MUST cite the live-verified state (the SHA observed at attestation time), NOT the assumed-from-context state (e.g., the dispatch-authoring SHA carried in the directive). Discipline-PASS vs honesty-PASS are separate properties; both required.

Lives at: operating-disciplines.md §19 (existing confabulation section).

## Out of scope (NOT in this canonification batch)

- **Empirical-premise-verification before LOCKING directives** — surfaced in audit today; bigger discipline shape (touches directive-authoring at user-tier POLYBIUS); needs its own arc, not a fold-in here.
- **HUMAN_paste-*.md accumulation at the-stoa root** — hygiene observation; tiny issue; can wait or piggyback on a future cleanup arc.
- **User-tier-committing-to-local-main discipline** — substrate convention gap (the-stoa CLAUDE.md says forward work on feature branches; user-tier has been committing housekeeping directly to main). Needs its own scope discussion; not folded here.
- **Orphaned arc-build worktree directories** — addressed via Arc 30 + manual cleanups today; no separate work needed.
- **Building stoa--32b.2 (mechanical-script / agent-inspection split)** — separate substantive arc; not a small canonification.

## Deliverables (DAEDALUS scopes precisely)

1. **C1 — §5.1.1 extension** at `substrate/MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md` (the existing §5.1.1 lives there per current canon). Add sub-discipline + anti-pattern example.
2. **C2 — cron-hygiene canon** at:
   - `substrate/templates/paste-instruction-template.md` — new `{{CRON_HYGIENE_CLAUSE}}` slot + default expansion (canonical preamble)
   - `substrate/MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md` §5.1.x — activation-paste convention
   - `substrate/operating-disciplines.md` — thin universal-team cross-ref
   - Mirror Arc 30's three-carrier framing for the pre-branch hygiene preamble.
3. **C3 — PLINY-signoff-accuracy** at `substrate/MAJOR_PLINY.md` (probably alongside §5.9 pre-branch hygiene; same family) OR `substrate/operating-disciplines.md` (universal-team). DAEDALUS picks locus.
4. **C4 — attestation-confabulation extension** at `substrate/operating-disciplines.md` §19 (extend existing confabulation section with attestation sub-rule).

## Acceptance (probes — VERA scopes precisely)

- `grep -n "cross-project sequencing\|cross-project context" substrate/MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md` — C1 sub-discipline present.
- `grep -n "{{CRON_HYGIENE_CLAUSE}}" substrate/templates/paste-instruction-template.md` — C2 slot present.
- `grep -n "cron hygiene\|orphaned cron" substrate/MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md substrate/operating-disciplines.md` — C2 convention + cross-ref present.
- `grep -n "signoff\|verify before claiming" substrate/MAJOR_PLINY.md substrate/operating-disciplines.md` — C3 discipline present at picked locus.
- `grep -n "attestation\|live-verified" substrate/operating-disciplines.md` — C4 attestation sub-rule in §19.
- Authorship audit: zero author-like fields touched.
- Cite-comments resolve.

## Gauntlet shape

Small-scope substrate-canon arc. Comparable to or slightly larger than Arc 30. Single DAEDALUS round + likely 1 ARGUS revise round. ADA + VERA + CATO + ZENO + ship. Wall-clock ~30-60 min CAPTAIN-agent estimated.

## §15 N=1 honesty

Each of C1-C4 has empirical anchors named above. C1 + C3 + C4 are N=2 or N=1 with today's session as the anchor; C2 is "encoded ad-hoc many times today" (multi-instance pattern). Substrate canon enters off-gate on PRINCIPAL-direction; future arcs accrete further evidence as the disciplines surface or fail to surface in operations.

## Cross-refs

- §5.1.1 current canon (the existing source that C1 extends)
- Arc 30 / stoa--3cs (the pre-branch hygiene three-carrier pattern C2 mirrors)
- operating-disciplines.md §19 (confabulation-under-uncertainty discipline C4 extends)
- 2026-05-16/17 session conversation (the empirical anchor surface)
- Arc 31 / stoa--32b.1 (sibling in-flight at dispatch authoring; PRINCIPAL-gate discipline)

[scope addition 2026-05-17 by user-tier POLYBIUS] **C5 candidate — arc-build worktree convention**

**Empirical anchor:** Arc 31 dispatch — PLINY operated arc-31/build IN the main workspace path (C:\Users\denso\claude_projects\the-stoa\ directly) rather than in a separate .claude/worktrees/arc-31-build/ subdirectory. The main worktree's checkout flipped from main to arc-31/build for the duration of PLINY's work. Arcs 26-30 (per their respective cleanups + worktree-list outputs) used separate .claude/worktrees/arc-N-build/ subdirs. Arc 31 was a divergence.

**The discipline question:** should the substrate encode whether arc-build branches require a separate worktree?

Two options:
- **Option A — require separate worktree.** Encode at MAJOR_PLINY.md §5.9 (alongside pre-branch hygiene; same family): "git worktree add .claude/worktrees/arc-N-build arc-N/build" is the canonical pattern. Main worktree stays on main. User-tier POLYBIUS can operate in main concurrently without checkout collision.
- **Option B — explicit allow main-worktree checkout.** Acknowledge both patterns; document tradeoffs; let PLINY pick. Risk: user-tier POLYBIUS operating in same path as PLINY's arc work can interfere (today: I had to hold position to avoid commits landing on arc-31/build).

I lean Option A. Separate worktree is cleaner separation; eliminates the checkout-flip-side-effect; matches the Arcs 26-30 de-facto pattern; and the worktree-removal at arc-close is mechanical (git worktree remove + git branch -D).

**Fits in Canonification Batch as C5.** Same shape as C1-C4 (small substrate canon tightening; empirical anchor; small surface). DAEDALUS picks Option A vs B as part of the arc work.
